response_text:
**Summary:**
The email informs you about an upcoming HVAC maintenance schedule for Building B, 3rd floor, on Saturday, October 17, from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. During this time, the HVAC units will be offline, affecting the cooling system in the west wing. The east wing will remain operational. If there are any lab freezers on the 3rd floor, samples should be moved to the 2nd-floor units by Friday end of day.

**Action Required:**
- No immediate action is needed from you, as this is a reminder email. However, if you have lab freezers on the 3rd floor of Building B, you should make arrangements to transfer the samples to the 2nd-floor units before Friday EOD to ensure they remain at the appropriate temperature during the maintenance.
- You may also want to share this information with your colleagues on the 3rd floor to ensure everyone is aware of the temporary disruption.
